main_body: A flat grass ground patch (about 72x16 px) with a few small flowers and dark grass tufts; terrain tile, no standing volume
top_band: none (flat ground surface; column scan shows uniform green L=97 with a few flower/tuft pixels)
evidence: Terrain kind: a ground patch seen from above with no standing body, so the top/front contract does not apply. It is not a front or side elevation and has no wall or cliff face. Ground terrain is acceptable as a flat surface.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 4 per tile, against 26 and 80 for the grass reference. Flat-fill coverage is 75% against 0% for the references. Most of the surface is one flat green (#3a7e30) with sparse single-pixel light specks and a few small dark tufts. There is no grain, no clump shading and no tonal variation like the reference grass, which uses several greens in patches. The dark tufts are tinted green, so they are not a sticker outline, but the ground reads as a flat fill and is much thinner than the reference.
